name: kh-winforms-user-style

scope.activation: actual target project or explicit comparator; not all C# projects

authority: Current user instructions and already agreed C# rules take priority; verified target APIs determine behavior. Recurring examples supplement unspecified style. Conflicting samples may be omissions, not new exceptions; no signature required.

defaults.numeric_editor: Use the actual Spin repository without adding Mask.EditMask by default; preserve existing editor behavior.
defaults.format_string: Do not add DisplayFormat.FormatType or FormatString by default; preserve existing settings; reports have separate requirements.

grid_layout.application: Use HTML Load Layout defaults when no specific additional behavior is required. Preserve verified existing user changes.
grid_layout.font_scope: Template font for newly generated grids only; retain current user-modified fonts.
grid_layout.default_column_mode: editable; no edit flags in the HTML baseline
grid_layout.OptionsBehavior: No default assignments. Preserve existing values and omissions; do not substitute view locks for column edit rules.
grid_layout.additional_options: Add only for a specific requested behavior or when omitting the option makes implementing required behavior difficult. Convenience is insufficient.

defaults.event_subscription: Named handlers after InitializeComponent in the existing constructor pattern; preserve existing wiring and subscribe once.

coding_style.source_scope: Seven solution-selected BA/SA/MA WinForms screens, reviewed 2026-09-08; backup and unselected copy projects excluded.
coding_style.blocks: Allman braces and four-space indentation. Use braces even for one-statement if/else/for/foreach/while/do bodies; retain else if chains.
coding_style.locals: Prefer explicit types and existing semantic prefixes; do not rename or reformat unrelated code.
coding_style.properties: Full get blocks; do not shorten to expression bodies.
coding_style.parsing: Separate parsing success checks from subsequent value comparisons.
coding_style.members: Follow existing SelectType, state fields, DataTable properties, constructor, screen command events and behavior helpers.
coding_style.database_calls: Keep CallSelectProcedure/CallSaveProcedure and align one DbParameter per line with a leading comma. Preserve actual SP modes, parameter types, transaction calls and XML row states.
coding_style.rows: Direct DataTable/DataRow and NewRow/field assignments/Rows.Add; reuse verified helpers without redundant Clone calls.
coding_style.exceptions: Use existing message/exception helpers at actual query/save boundaries; never copy an unfinished success-returning stub.
coding_style.sample_conflicts: Unbraced statements, inline parsing shortcuts, unused imports and inconsistent Designer properties in references do not weaken agreed rules.

user_controls.scope: Every suitable user control available in the actual target project; not limited to KoneLib or a namespace/prefix.
user_controls.selection: Prefer the suitable user control before raw DevExpress/WinForms controls; verify actual project references and APIs.
user_controls.initialization: Read constructor, InitializeComponent, initialization helpers and inheritance. Retain their defaults unless a specific current requirement needs a change.
user_controls.assignments: Set screen-owned names, layout placement, captions, bindings, events and required overrides only. Do not invent, duplicate or overwrite control defaults.
user_controls.values: Use actual current control source, not global font/size/AutoHeight/mask constants. Do not universalize conditional/culture/runtime settings.

control_names.numeric_repository: rpsSpin<Field>; when another grid uses the same field, rps<Role>Spin<Field> (List rpsSpinQTY, Detail rpsDetailSpinQTY). Keep the existing name; Role goes before Spin.
control_names.label: lbl<FieldOrRole>
control_names.scope: Agreed defaults for newly written controls, restored from pre-3.0 KH; preserve current explicit naming instructions and avoid unrelated legacy renames.

defaults.date_input: Do not add DisplayFormat/EditFormat/EditMask/Mask settings just because the input is a date. Inherit the selected control initialization; add only the missing behavior required by the current request.

preference_exceptions: Only when avoiding the disfavored method makes implementation difficult or the alternative has an extremely large performance disadvantage; convenience is insufficient.
source: User-validated scoped patterns, 2026-09-07 log audit, and 2026-09-08 direct grid corrections plus DataWindowToXml.html. Also supplemented by a 2026-09-08 review of seven user-designated BA/SA/MA screens; explicit prior corrections remain authoritative. 2026-09-08 general user-control corrections and pre-3.0 semantic naming restored after checking the referenced source history.
